mapper.select: WITH hold_flow AS ( SELECT USR_SN, PT_LDG_REF_SN AS BID_SN, SUM(PT_LDG_AMT) AS holdAmount FROM POINT_LEDGER WHERE PT_LDG_PT_TYPE_CD = 'PTLC0002' AND PT_LDG_REF_TYPE_CD = 'REFC0004' AND PT_LDG_REF_SN IS NOT NULL GROUP BY USR_SN, PT_LDG_REF_SN HAVING SUM(PT_LDG_AMT) > 0 ), hold_diagnostics AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001' AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ('AUCC0002', 'AUCC0006', 'AUCC0013', 'AUCC9001') THEN 0 ELSE h.holdAmount END), 0) AS attentionHoldAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001' AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ('AUCC0002', 'AUCC0006', 'AUCC0013', 'AUCC9001') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 0) AS attentionHoldCount FROM hold_flow h LEFT JOIN BID b ON b.BID_SN = h.BID_SN AND b.USR_SN = h.USR_SN LEFT JOIN AUCTION a ON a.AUC_SN = b.AUC_SN ), escrow_flow AS ( SELECT PT_LDG_REF_TYPE_CD, PT_LDG_REF_SN, SUM(CASE WHEN PT_LDG_TYPE_CD IN ('PTLC0007', 'PTLC0013') THEN PT_LDG_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS escrowNet, SUM(CASE WHEN PT_LDG_TYPE_CD = 'PTLC0008' THEN PT_LDG_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS settledAmount FROM POINT_LEDGER WHERE PT_LDG_REF_TYPE_CD IS NOT NULL AND PT_LDG_REF_SN IS NOT NULL AND PT_LDG_TYPE_CD IN ('PTLC0007', 'PTLC0008', 'PTLC0013') GROUP BY PT_LDG_REF_TYPE_CD, PT_LDG_REF_SN ), escrow_summary AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-escrowNet), 0) AS activeEscrowAmount FROM escrow_flow WHERE escrowNet < 0 AND settledAmount = 0 ) SELECT (SELECT activeEscrowAmount FROM escrow_summary) AS activeEscrowAmount, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(STLM_AMT) FROM SETTLEMENT WHERE STLM_STATUS_CD = 'STLC0002' ), 0) AS heldSettlementAmount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SETTLEMENT WHERE STLM_STATUS_CD = 'STLC0002' ), 0) AS heldSettlementCount, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(PT_EXC_ORD_AMT) FROM POINT_EXCHANGE_ORDER WHERE PT_EXC_ORD_STATUS_CD = 'PEOC0001' ), 0) AS pendingExchangeAmount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POINT_EXCHANGE_ORDER WHERE PT_EXC_ORD_STATUS_CD = 'PEOC0001' ), 0) AS pendingExchangeCount, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PT_LDG_PT_TYPE_CD = 'PTLC0001' THEN PT_LDG_AMT ELSE 0 END) FROM POINT_LEDGER ), 0) AS availablePointBalance, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PT_LDG_PT_TYPE_CD = 'PTLC0002' THEN PT_LDG_AMT ELSE 0 END) FROM POINT_LEDGER ), 0) AS holdPointBalance, (SELECT attentionHoldAmount FROM hold_diagnostics) AS attentionHoldAmount, (SELECT attentionHoldCount FROM hold_diagnostics) AS attentionHoldCount, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PT_LDG_PT_TYPE_CD = 'PTLC0003' THEN PT_LDG_AMT ELSE 0 END) FROM POINT_LEDGER ), 0) AS settleablePointBalance
